intro: Laos aims to be the 'battery of Southeast Asia' by selling hydropower to its neighbours.

chapters.title: Dams
text: Dozens of dams on the Mekong and its tributaries produce electricity, much of it sold to Thailand. The dams worry fishermen downstream.

chapters.title: Debt
text: Mining, farming and tourism are growing, but large debts, much of it owed to China, have caused high inflation.

keyTerms.meaning: A river that flows into a bigger river.

cardGroups.title: Made in Laos
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Laos makes and sells to the world.
